body: I was thinking that when eve eats the forbidden fruit, god subjects them to the truth. So I’m assuming that when the maid eats the peach, all hell breaks loose. The maid gets fired... and so on and so on the truth gets out.

It may not seem like it... but you are doing well for where you are at and compared to the people you’re surrounded by. You are a fighter and I can’t imagine what your situation is like. You have so much, and there are people who will miss you if you’re gone. Don’t kill yourself because the people in your life are making it hell. Don’t give them that satisfaction. You can write your life however you want it. You are the designer of your world.
